# Porokh (পরোখ)

> Porokh (পরোখ) is a Bangladesh-focused educational technology platform for exam
> preparation. Students in Bangladesh use it to practise MCQ questions, take
> timed model tests, work through question banks and prepare for SSC, HSC, board
> and university admission examinations.

## Facts

- Brand: Porokh (Bangla name: পরোখ)
- Category: educational technology platform, online exam preparation
- Audience: school, college and university admission candidates in Bangladesh
- Languages: Bangla (default) and English
- Platforms: web (mobile and desktop) and Android
- Accounts: a free account can be created; some extra features are part of premium plans

## Public pages

- [Home](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/): what Porokh is, what students can do on it, and how to start
- [About](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/about): the purpose of the platform and who it is built for
- [FAQ](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/faq): direct answers about the platform, cost and devices
- [Contact](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/contact): support form, email address and Facebook page
- [Privacy Policy](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/privacy-policy): what student data is stored and why
- [Terms & Conditions](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/terms-conditions): rules for using the platform
- [Cookie Policy](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/cookie-policy): cookies and browser storage that is used
- [Data Deletion](https://porokhbd.vercel.app/data-deletion): how to delete an account and its data

## Notes

- The student application (dashboard, exam attempts, progress, profile, groups) requires an account and is not public.
- This file and the public pages are the only first-party source for these facts. Ratings, prices, statistics, partnerships and awards are not stated here because they are not published by Porokh.
